content.detail: Return one complete JSON object or array; malformed or multiple values are not accepted. JSON error at line 12, column 1: Extra data
content.instruction: Return ONE complete JSON value. Never batch actions or return a partial final array.

rules.cwe_name: Reliance on Undefined, Unspecified, or Implementation-Defined Behavior
rules.description: If an HTML element has two attributes with the same name but different values, its behavior may be browser-dependent.

rules.cwe_name: Excessive Iteration
rules.description: Iterating over an object with a user-controlled .length property can cause indefinite looping.

rules.cwe_name: Use of Potentially Dangerous Function
rules.description: DOM functions that act like 'eval' and execute strings as code are dangerous and impede program analysis and understanding. Consequently, they should not be used.

rules.cwe_name: Loop with Unreachable Exit Condition ('Infinite Loop')
rules.description: A 'for' loop that increments its loop variable but checks it against a lower bound, or decrements its loop variable but checks it against an upper bound, will either stop iterating immediately or keep iterating indefinitely, and is usually indicative of a typo.

rules.cwe_name: Assignment to Variable without Use
rules.description: If an object literal has two properties with the same name, the second property overwrites the first one, which makes the code hard to understand and error-prone.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Encoding or Escaping of Output
rules.description: Replacing a substring with itself has no effect and may indicate a mistake.

rules.cwe_name: Off-by-one Error
rules.description: An array index is compared to be less than or equal to the 'length' property, and then used in an indexing operation that could be out of bounds.

rules.cwe_name: Incorrect Type Conversion or Cast
rules.description: Assigning to a property of a primitive value has no effect and may trigger a runtime error.

rules.cwe_name: Function Call With Incorrect Number of Arguments
rules.description: A function is invoked with extra trailing arguments that are ignored.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')
rules.description: Modifying an object obtained via a user-controlled property name may lead to accidental mutation of the built-in Object prototype, and possibly escalate to remote code execution or cross-site scripting.
